flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No work item code for appeal addresses. Nearby code: ocmsadminapi reports/system/hst/{HstReportController,HstAdHocReportServiceImpl} + OcmsFurnishApplicationRepository.findAlternativeAddressByDateRange (ad-hoc report of furnished address vs HST), ocmsadminapi HstManagementServiceImpl (update-hst, revive-hst), ocmsadminui routes /hst/update and /hst/revival
note: Story status is 'Requirement given - Gen flow' and depends fully on OCMS20.23 (appeal detection). Because detection does not exist, the work item and the routing to a dashboard do not exist either; the staff UI only has the UPL Endorsement work item. The ad-hoc report GET /v1/hst/reports/alternative-address (ocmsadminapi) looks similar in content (HST address next to another address) but its source is furnish applications, not PLUS appeals, it is on-demand and has no caller in ocmsadminui; it is not claimed and is logged in the orphans file. The OIC follow-up step shares the fit of OCMS20.22 (update/revive tools exist, not connected to a work item). No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim (apart from the general staff follow-up tools). The work item and dashboard routing for appeal addresses do not exist.

steps.step: OCMS detects a new appeal under the ID with an alternative address different from the registered address
steps.detail: There is no code that detects a new appeal or an alternative address from an appeal (see OCMS20.23, same step: no job pulling from PLUS, no storage of the appeal address; PlusIntegrationController.java:65, :136, :185 only cover furnish/redirect). A nearby report exists but its source is different: GET /v1/hst/reports/alternative-address (HstReportController.java:81) joins ocms_furnish_application with ocms_hst (OcmsFurnishApplicationRepository.java:129-146), i.e. the furnish_mail address of a furnish application, not an appeal address. The report is on-demand and has no caller in ocmsadminui (grep for alternative-address / hst/reports is empty). It is not claimed as a substitute.

steps.step: OCMS creates a work item with the existing address in OCMS and the new address from the appeal
steps.detail: There is no work item or report that compares the OCMS address with an appeal address. The ad-hoc alternative-address report shows the HST address (hstStreetName etc.) next to the furnish_mail address, but from furnish applications, with no work item and no automatic trigger (HstAdHocReportServiceImpl.java:80-100; OcmsFurnishApplicationRepository.java:129-146).

steps.step: The work item is routed to the OIC's dashboard
steps.detail: There is no OIC dashboard or inbox for appeal address items. The staff UI has no HST work item concept; the only work item there is 'UPL Endorsement' (ocmsadminui/src/utils/constant.ts:300-303).

steps.step: The OIC follows up on that ID (update or lift HST) in the staff portal
steps.detail: The follow-up tools exist: routes /hst/update and /hst/revival (App.tsx:196-200) call update-hst and revive-hst (HstManagementServiceImpl.java:354, :419); authorization comes from the OCMS_HST_UPDATE and OCMS_HST_REVIVAL mappings (api-authorization.properties:99-103). But the OIC has to look up the ID manually; there is no link from a work item/report to this screen, and the new address from ICA/DOS or the appeal must be retyped in the form.
